data.content:
Here are the sampling sites with the highest number of distinct detected substances (where median_concentration > 0), aggregated over all sampled year-quarters:

| Site Name            | Number of Detected Substances |
|----------------------|------------------------------|
| moine a getigne      | 445                          |
| semnon a plechatel   | 433                          |
| gouessant a coetmieux| 418                          |
| seiche a bruz        | 413                          |
| odet a quimper       | 406                          |

Summary:
- The site "moine a getigne" has the highest number of distinct detected substances (445).
- Across all sites, the number of detected substances ranges from 65 to 445, with a median of 118 and an upper quartile of 193.5.

Cypher query used:
```cypher
MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE r.median_concentration > 0
WITH l.name AS SiteName, count(DISTINCT s.DTXSID) AS DetectedSubstances
RETURN SiteName, DetectedSubstances
ORDER BY DetectedSubstances DESC
```

For the complete dataset and further exploration, you can access the full Neo4j graph database at this Zenodo link: https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
